title: More room for text requests
summary:
Text requests got four times the room, image fallback got simpler, and referral links got less frequent.

The text request limit increased fourfold, from 512,000 to 2,048,000 characters. Model listings now describe `openai` as GPT-4.1-mini and `openai-large` as GPT-4.1; `openai-reasoning` and `gemini` were removed from the available-model list.

If Cloudflare Dreamshaper fails, image generation now falls through to the general ComfyUI call rather than trying a dedicated Turbo fallback first.

Referral-link insertion probabilities dropped from 10% to 3% normally and from 30% to 6% when trigger words match. The affiliate list and selection weights were adjusted too.

highlights.title: More room for text
highlights.text: Text requests now accept up to 2,048,000 characters, up from 512,000. [See the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
